items.description: App for IPhone and iPod touch that lets you upload a camera image, or a picture from the Image Library or from your Facebook photo albums, and find out what celebrities you and your friends look like. The app looks ONLY at your face features, not skin color or hair color. Share the results, morph your face with your twin, learn about the celebrities, buy celebrity stuff and find other people who look like your twin.
Online passport and visa photo service that provides guaranteed government compliance based on sophisticated biometrics.
